item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J01450","case1_error":"Leading answer 20 conflicts with the correct derivation and conclusion of 15 minutes.","case2_error":"Leading answer 1000 conflicts with the correct derivation and conclusion of $1250.","reason":"Both contain only answer-marker conflicts; neither derivation shows a mathematical error.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J01451","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 19 after outlining the correct steak-count procedure; the correct total is 17.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 30 after correct revenue and profit formulas; the correct profit is $10.","reason":"Both append incorrect final numbers to correct procedures without showing the calculation responsible.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J01452","case1_error":"Omits Ted’s four eaten cookies, reporting the intermediate remainder 138 instead of the final 134.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final earnings of $6351 after the correct formula, which yields $6318.","reason":"Case 1 omits a required subtraction; case 2 supplies an incorrect final number without showing erroneous arithmetic.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01453","case1_error":"Gives unsupported final total 22 after the correct formula (56/8)+(48/6), which yields 15.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 26+22 as 38 within the correctly written union expression, producing 21 instead of 31.","reason":"Case 1 shows no calculation supporting its wrong final number; case 2 explicitly shows a numerical evaluation error.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J01454","case1_error":"Applies only two halvings over 30 years, incorrectly assigning the first halving to age 20.","case2_error":"Replaces the payout multiplier 3/2 with 3, forming the incorrect equation 60=Bet×3.","reason":"Case 1 misses a required repeated halving; case 2 mistranslates a ratio into an equation.","judgment":"different"}]}
